changes.oldText: Fair share scheduling allocates compute resources based on historical usage patterns, ensuring that resources are distributed fairly among users. Users who have consumed fewer resources in the past receive higher scheduling priority, while those who have used more resources are given lower priority. Administrators can fine-tune this behavior by adjusting weights at each level of the hierarchy.
